{{Quote|I've seen some impressive things as a stormtrooper of the Empire. I've seen Star Destroyers tear apart a battlecruiser with just tractor beams. I've seen command ships so big they take three days to walk from end to end. I even saw Lord Vader once. But I think the greatest thing I ever saw was those squat little dropships, flying out of a binary sunset, loaded with reinforcements, ammunition, medical droids and food.|Imperial stormtrooper|<ref name="TFUIIDB" />}}
An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]<ref name="TFUIIDB" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CVD" /> '''stormtrooper''' fought alongside another [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], [[HJ-377]], against a [[Unidentified rebel group|rebel group]]<ref name="TFUIIDB" /> sometime before or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFUIIc">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the in-game databank therefore must have taken place by 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> After defending a hill for three [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] were running low on supplies and were fighting in hard conditions. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], explosions began to shake the ground, and HJ-377 went mad, thinking it was the rebels. However, it was in fact [[Imperial Dropship Transport/Legends|Imperial dropships]] coming to assist the Imperials by bringing reinforcements, ammunition, [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], and food. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] later remarked that, although having witnessed many impressive things in life, the stormtrooper considered that [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] to be one of the greatest things.<ref name="TFUIIDB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper was mentioned in the "Imperial dropship" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUIIDB" />
